lines.text: Right triangles in thirty seconds. Go.
One angle is exactly ninety degrees.
Across from it: the hypotenuse, always the longest side.
a squared plus b squared equals c squared.
Three, four, five: nine plus sixteen is twenty five.
Learn the triples: five, twelve, thirteen. Eight, fifteen, seventeen. And six, eight, ten.
Forty five, forty five, ninety: x, x, x root two.
Thirty, sixty, ninety: x, x root three, two x.
SOH CAH TOA. Sine: opposite over hypotenuse. Cosine: adjacent over hypotenuse. Tangent: opposite over adjacent.
Quick test: legs six and eight. Hypotenuse?
Ten. It's three four five, doubled.
